item.tib: khro bo rol pa thugs dug gsum gtan sprug gi 'phrin las gzhung
item.coloph: dug gsum za byed khrag 'thung 'di/ rgya gar zhang zhung yul nas ni/ lo paN kun gyi (gyis) bod du bsgyur ba'o/ dar rgud byung dus gter du sbas/ gter sgo sa mo sbrul lor 'byed/ stong rgyung mthu chen gyis thugs dam mdzad/ de nas mkhas pa rim pa rgyud/ skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog bstan pa srung phyir e ma ho/ sprul pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// rdzogs so/ a+tha/
